datasets.label: Enhanced FRS 2024-25 (policyengine-uk-data 1.57.3)
datasets.producer: policyengine-uk-data 1.57.3, Hugging Face model repo policyengine/policyengine-uk-data at tag 1.57.3 (commit 25af520a, 2026-09-04)
datasets.observation: FRS 2024-25 households; capital gains imputed onto survey households and household weights calibrated to HMRC CGT aggregates and size-of-gain bands
datasets.notes: Carries capital_gains only: no asset-type breakdown, so the engine charges every gain on the main CGT schedule.

datasets.label: Microcosm UK 2024, spine assessment v20 (staged candidate)
datasets.producer: microcosm build uk-frs-calibration-attempt-20260918T174754Z-3f928f19, staged 2026-09-18 as run uk-spine-assessment-v20-calibration in the Hugging Face dataset repo policyengine/populace-uk-private (commit 25e40b24); a staging candidate whose terminal gates passed, not a certified release
datasets.observation: FRS 2024-25 spine; capital gains amounts redrawn from HMRC Table 3 (size of gain by taxable income, 2024-25) with asset types from HMRC Tables 7 and 8, and household weights calibrated to HMRC CGT totals, age, region and size bands for 2024-25
datasets.notes: Carries capital_gains and capital_gains_residential_property (the residential schedule); no BADR or carried-interest columns. Gainers beyond HMRC's taxpayer count keep their gains capped at the annual exempt amount, so 10.8 million people sit at exactly GBP 3,000 in the base year.
